```{r}
library(pacman)
library(rgee)
```



```{r}
rgee::ee_clean_user_credentials()
rgee_environment_directory <- "/opt/anaconda3/envs/rgee_py/bin/python"

p_load(raster,
       rgdal,
       rgeos,
       gdalUtils,
       sp,
       sf,
       leaflet,
       mapview,
       caret,
       terra)
p_load(rgee, geojsonio, remotes, reticulate, devtools, googledrive)

# set python
reticulate::use_python(rgee_environment_directory, required=T)
rgee::ee_install_set_pyenv(
  py_path = rgee_environment_directory, # Change it for your own Python PATH
  py_env = "rgee_py" # Change it for your own Python ENV
)
Sys.setenv(RETICULATE_PYTHON = rgee_environment_directory)
Sys.setenv(EARTHENGINE_PYTHON = rgee_environment_directory)

rgee::ee_Initialize(drive = T)
```
